name: curseforge-mod-uploader
description: Upload a whole release folder of Minecraft mod jars to CurseForge in one go. Loader, game version, Java version, display name and dependencies are filled in from each jar.

curseforgeUpload.projects.markdownDescription: CurseForge project per mod, keyed by the mod part of the jar name (for `weaponry-fabric-2.5.0+1.20.1.jar` that is `weaponry`). Filled in automatically the first time you upload. Example: `{ "weaponry": { "projectId": 123456, "name": "Weaponry Extended", "dependencies": { "fabric": ["fabric-api"] } } }`

curseforgeUpload.filenamePattern.markdownDescription: Regular expression that reads a jar's file name. It needs the named groups `mod`, `loader`, `version` and `mc`. The default matches `<mod>-<loader>-<version>+<mc>.jar`.

curseforgeUpload.displayNameTemplate.markdownDescription: Display name for each uploaded file. Placeholders: `{name}` (mod display name), `{mod}`, `{version}`, `{loader}`, `{Loader}`, `{mc}`, `{java}`, `{filename}`.

curseforgeUpload.defaultReleaseType.description: Release type preselected in the upload form.

curseforgeUpload.defaultDependencies.markdownDescription: Required CurseForge dependencies (project slugs) per loader for mods that have no dependencies saved yet. Empty by default, so no dependencies are added unless you set them. Example: `{ "fabric": ["fabric-api"] }`.

curseforgeUpload.environments.description: Environment tags preselected on every file. Empty by default: pick Client and/or Server in the form (Environment, all files). CurseForge requires at least one.

curseforgeUpload.addJavaVersion.description: Preselect the Java version read from each jar's compiled classes. Each file can still be changed in the form.

curseforgeUpload.apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the CurseForge upload API.
